question: In relation to phase III clinical trials conducted in oncology, point out the true answer:

options.opa: The response rate is usually used as the main variable, since it is considered clinically relevant under any circumstance.
options.opb: In frequent tumors, such as colon cancer, phase III clinical trials are usually uncontrolled clinical trials.
options.opc: When the existence of important prognostic factors of the type of cancer under study is known, it is advisable to stratify the randomization to ensure an equitable distribution of these factors.
options.opd: Very strict inclusion criteria that exclude certain types of patients (for example elderly patients) should be used, as this will make the results more general.
